decisions.reason: Its survival into 2024 and promotion on its own page suggest results at least near aspiration, and this established, complementary care product is easy for a growing firm with some slack to retain.
It remained on the website in 2024, so performance likely did not clearly fail aspiration, but the weaker visibility than A and C makes it somewhat more exposed if management reallocates resources.
A dedicated 2024 page indicates satisfactory early market acceptance relative to aspiration, and as a close extension of the core flooring business it fits the firm's capabilities well.

The product still appears in 2024 and supports the flooring system offer, but only being mentioned rather than highlighted suggests middling results and a moderate risk of problemistic search if priorities tighten.
It is still marketed, yet its limited prominence and likely overlap with other underlay solutions make it one of the more vulnerable items if it underperforms aspiration.
As an oak parquet floor close to the firm's core business, it benefits from strong capability fit and strategic relevance, so continued retention is likely unless sales clearly disappoint.
